# Pushing the ground

<!-- STEP id="bicycle" -->
Sit on a bicycle and do not pedal. To move forward, you push the ground backwards with your feet. The ground pushes your feet forwards, so you and the bicycle move forward.

<!-- STEP id="walk" -->
Walking and running work the same way. Your foot pushes the ground backwards. The ground pushes your foot forwards.

This force from the ground is friction. Here, friction helps you move instead of opposing your motion.
